name: SlurpyCoin
fix_description: In swapEthForTokens, the swap is executed with 0 minimum output (no slippage protection). Called from BuyOrSell during auto-buyback, attacker manipulates pair price then triggers buyback via a transfer to sandwich the swap. Fix: set reasonable amountOutMin based on oracle or TWAP price.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step tokenomics/manipulation attack using a flash loan, repeated transfer-triggered side effects, helper contracts, and staged dumping to realize profit. While not deeply complex protocol-internals work, it requires understanding the custom SLURPY transfer/BuyOrSell behavior and orchestrating several coordinated interactions beyond a simple one-call bug.
